newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Two die, 30 hurt in Bogota grenade attack.
newsitem.headline: Two die, 30 hurt in Bogota grenade attack.

text.p: BOGOTA, Aug 19 Reuter - Two people were killed and 30 injured when an unidentified attacker threw a hand grenade into a crowded Bogota restaurant, police said on Tuesday.
The explosion occurred late Monday, a national holiday in Colombia, as people dined and listened to live music.

The female vocalist of a band playing in the restaurant was seriously injured in the blast and police said she may have to have both legs amputated. Another musician used his guitar to shield himself from flying shrapnel, a metropolitan police spokesman said.

The motives for the attack were not immediately clear but police said they were investigating whether the intended target was a candidate for forthcoming local council elections, thought to have been in the restaurant at the time.

"We're still not exactly sure what happened there. People say a single man threw the grenade into the restaurant from outside. We don't really know if he intended to hurt a definite person or if it was a random attack," the police spokesman said.
